mathviz is the machinery behind [Visual Math Lab](https://www.visualmathlab.com), packaged so any site can use it: a **Quarto extension** that drops into an OJS page with one line of front matter, and the same code as a **plain script bundle** for everything else.

Every chart, panel and slider on this site is drawn by the library itself. Toggle the theme in the navbar and watch them follow.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-row}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof heroF = Inputs.text({label: "f(x)", value: "sin(x) + x/3"})
```
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof heroK = Inputs.range([0.5, 4], {label: "k", step: 0.05, value: 1})
```
:::

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const f = VM.expressions.makeFunction(math, heroF)
  const df = VM.expressions.makeDerivative(math, heroF)
  const xs = [], ys = [], dys = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
    const x = -6 + 12 * i / 400
    xs.push(x)
    ys.push(f ? f(heroK * x) : NaN)
    dys.push(df ? heroK * df(heroK * x) : NaN)
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  div.style.height = "380px"; div.style.minHeight = "0"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [
    {x: xs, y: ys, name: "f(kx)", line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 2.5}},
    {x: xs, y: dys, name: "d/dx f(kx)", line: {color: chartColors.alt, width: 1.5, dash: "dot"}}
  ], {
    xaxis: {title: "x"},
    legend: {x: 0.01, y: 0.99},
    annotations: f ? [] : VM.plotting.emptyState("Couldn't parse that expression")
  })
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```
:::

## What you get

- **Themed charts.** Plotly and Observable Plot read the same fonts, grid, palette and tooltip style from CSS custom properties, live -- so charts follow your site's light/dark toggle and re-theme the instant it flips. The Plotly patch does this to every chart on the page with no per-page code.
- **A modebar worth using.** Fullscreen, gentler zoom steps, pan by default, no box/lasso select.
- **Control-panel CSS** that lays Observable `Inputs.*` out into a tidy panel, and keeps step sliders directly above a chart -- also in fullscreen.
- **Slider playback**: every range slider in a panel gets a play/pause button with speed and loop/bounce options.
- **A floating, draggable legend** that toggles traces and remembers where you put it.
- **Numerical helpers**: safe expression parsing via math.js, ODE steppers, quadrature, least-squares, sixteen closed-form densities, seeded random numbers, 1-D filters, Sperner triangulations.

## Install

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Quarto

```sh
quarto add apurvanakade/mathviz
```

```yaml
# _quarto.yml
filters:
  - mathviz
```

That's it -- math.js, Plotly, `mathviz.js` and `mathviz.css` are in every page's `<head>`, in that order, served from your own `site_libs/`.

## Any web page

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/apurvanakade/mathviz@v0.1.2/dist/mathviz.css">
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/apurvanakade/mathviz@v0.1.2/dist/mathviz.js"></script>
```

Load Plotly **before** the bundle.

:::

Details, options and pinning: [Installing](install.qmd).
